verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox, staging, or test environment that is kept separate from production. The free 10,000-page tier, sample quickstart files, dedicated instances with "full data isolation," and community self-hosting via Docker are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not an isolated testing environment. Data isolation between tenants is not the same as a sandbox for testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
